story: Ivo Sandre countersigned brake certificates for carriage four after the Dunmore depot flooded. He sold the stamp's work for cash and never inspected a pad.
Ansel Corbin found the forgery. At ten to midnight he left a voicemail saying he would name the signer at Lorne, and he warned Ivo the board would hear of it.
At Gram, Ivo carried Dr. Pell's bag and took a strip of somnex. He leaned in at the pantry hatch while Tilda fetched honey and crushed tablets into Ansel's toddy.
At a quarter past two, with the train on Harrow Viaduct, Ivo walked the drowsy auditor to the car four to five door, opened it with his own card, and pushed. A cuff button tore loose in the struggle.
Ivo relocked the door and returned to the van. Calla, Pell and Tilda heard only the wind in cabin seven.

deductions.claim: Only Ivo's card, C-01, opened the outer door at 02:14, and his missing cuff button matches the one beside the slipper.
Ansel was about to name the signer of forged brake certificates, initialled I. S.
Ansel was sedated with the doctor's stolen tablets in his toddy, then walked out of the outer door on the viaduct.
